profile.name: 电力路由软件组件
profile.description: 非物理软件组件，用于在实验或设施能源管理场景中统一表示可参与电力调度的对象。它提供配置加载、运行与停止、功率查询、可释放功率计算、功率占用以及状态发布等接口，可被智能插座、电池或充电控制对象等上层模块复用。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component used to represent objects that can participate in power scheduling in laboratory or facility energy-management scenarios. It provides interfaces for loading configuration, running and stopping, querying power, calculating releasable power, taking power, and publishing status, and can be reused by higher-level modules such as smart plugs, batteries, or EVSE control objects.

registry.name: Routable
registry.description: Routable是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、功率读取、加载、触发、运行。支持Signal, Slot, advance state等操作。
